body: In 1900, sponge divers found a wreck off Antikythera.
Its cargo included a strange, corroded bronze lump.
Inside were precision-cut gears packed together.
The mechanism was built over two thousand years ago.
A hand crank moved pointers across astronomical dials.
One dial tracked the Sun and Moon.
Others modeled cycles used to predict eclipses.
Another tracked the cycle of major Greek games.
Its inscriptions even explained parts of its operation.
optional_closing: So this ancient computer was a mechanical model of the heavens.

In 1900, sponge divers found a wreck off Antikythera. Its cargo included a strange, corroded bronze lump. Inside were precision-cut gears packed together. Another tracked the cycle of major Greek games. Its inscriptions even explained parts of its operation. So this ancient computer was a mechanical model of the heavens.
